Cover Flow Browse covers in 3D – drag, flick or scrub the row, it springs to the nearest cover; images drift in their frames over a soft reflection. $ pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/cover-flow.json Preview Code Copy prompt MCP Copy Blush #FDF2F8 → #F5B5D6 When to use Six to twenty visual items where looking at one at a time is the point – albums, places, products, case studies, templates A showcase row that should feel physical: drag, flick, sideways trackpad scroll When not to use Text-heavy slides or many items to compare side by side – use a plain carousel or a grid Large libraries – a grid with a lightbox scales better Installation Add Cover Flow with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19. CLI Manual pnpm npm yarn bun Copy pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/cover-flow.json Usage example.tsx Copy import { CoverFlow } from "@/components/ui/cover-flow"; export function Albums() { return ( openAlbum(item.id)} /> ); } Examples Portrait cards, own caption example.tsx Copy ( <> {item.title} {item.subtitle} )} /> Controlled, with a soft click example.tsx Copy const [index, setIndex] = useState(0); API reference CoverFlow Prop Type Default Description items CoverFlowItem[] – { id, title?, subtitle?, image?, alt?, cover? } – pass an image URL or any ReactNode as cover index number – Controlled front cover – pair with onIndexChange defaultIndex number middle cover Starting cover when uncontrolled onIndexChange (index: number) => void – Called whenever a different cover reaches the front, also while dragging onSelect (item, index) => void – Clicking the front cover or pressing Enter – e.g. open a detail view itemWidth number 280 Cover width in px – the whole row scales down in narrow containers (to half at most) itemHeight number 280 Cover height in px angle number 50 How far the side covers turn away, in degrees reflection boolean true Mirror the covers on the floor caption boolean true Title and subtitle of the front cover renderCaption (item, index) => ReactNode – Replaces the default caption controls boolean true Previous and next buttons beside the caption ticks boolean true Small position ticks under the caption – clicking one jumps there sound boolean false A soft click each time a new cover reaches the front (Web Audio, no file) aria-label string "Cover flow" Names the carousel className string – Extra class on the root Keyboard interactions ← or → Previous or next cover while the row has focus Home or End First or last cover ↵ Selects the front cover (calls onSelect) Accessibility A region with aria-roledescription="carousel"; each cover is a group with aria-roledescription="slide" and a label like "3 of 10: Alpenglow" Covers away from the front are aria-hidden; the reflections are aria-hidden and inert The caption is a polite live region, so the new front cover is announced Previous / next are real buttons; the ticks are labelled "Show " with aria-current and stay out of the tab order Motion A spring carries the row: drag 1:1, flick and it travels with your speed, then lands on a cover – a quick flick always moves at least one Sideways trackpad scrolling scrubs the row and settles in the direction of the swipe; vertical scrolling stays with the page Covers turn, recede, scale down and dim with distance; a light sheen sits on the side facing the center and each image drifts inside its frame The ends rubber-band; the caption rises in from the direction of travel With prefers-reduced-motion covers jump into place and the drift is off Responsive behavior Scales with its container down to half size; touch-action pan-y keeps vertical swipes scrolling the page Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme="dark" Performance Positions are written straight to transforms each frame;
